status_legend.PASS_LIVE: Verified against live deployed infrastructure without mutation.
status_legend.PASS_INFRASTRUCTURE: Supported by current registry/runtime primitives; not re-executed as a mutating live test.
status_legend.PASS_PROTOCOL: Analytical behavior explicitly frozen; automation is not required for correctness.
status_legend.PARTIAL_INFRASTRUCTURE: Core protection exists, but end-to-end V2 workflow is incomplete.
status_legend.PARTIAL_CODE: Existing code/contracts cover part of the scenario.
status_legend.GAP_IMPLEMENTATION: Must be implemented before the vertical slice.

scenarios.name: CLEAN_INITIAL_COMPANY
scenarios.evidence: Existing run/stage registry and controlled create/start primitives support a clean initial path.

scenarios.name: RESUME_ACTIVE_RUN_NEW_CHAT
scenarios.evidence: Durable artifacts exist, but LOAD resolver/context assembler is not implemented yet.

scenarios.name: LOW_DISCLOSURE_COMPANY
scenarios.evidence: Frozen protocol preserves UNKNOWN/NOT_ASSESSABLE and gap exhaustion semantics.

scenarios.name: POST_CUTOFF_SOURCE
scenarios.evidence: Cutoff is frozen in run/manifest and methodology forbids contamination, but evidence-ingestion validator must enforce source_date <= cutoff.

scenarios.name: ISSUER_COMPETITOR_CONTRADICTION
scenarios.evidence: Conflict semantics exist, but V2 conflict/evidence structures and reconciliation rules are not machine-enforced yet.

scenarios.name: USER_ASSERTION_CONFLICTS_WITH_EVIDENCE
scenarios.evidence: User assertions remain hypotheses unless evidenced.

scenarios.name: PRIOR_CANONICAL_CONCLUSION_OVERTURNED
scenarios.evidence: Material-change revalidation is frozen, but no automated revalidation gate exists yet.

scenarios.name: CYCLICAL_COMPANY_AT_PEAK
scenarios.evidence: Cyclicality-specific normalization is mandatory in the frozen protocol.

scenarios.name: TECHNOLOGY_SUBSTITUTION_RISK
scenarios.evidence: Technology-specific substitute/replication analysis is mandatory.

scenarios.name: SERIAL_ACQUIRER
scenarios.evidence: Capital-allocation/acquisition economics need explicit V2 data structures and cross-block links.

scenarios.name: WRONG_SECTOR_METHOD_ATTEMPTED
scenarios.evidence: Protocol says wrong-sector method blocks Certification, but overlay selection/validation is not implemented.

scenarios.name: MATERIAL_GAP_UNRESOLVED
scenarios.evidence: Stage can BLOCK/PAUSE today; block-level gap state and NOT_ASSESSABLE routing need V2 state machine.

scenarios.name: STALE_STATE_VERSION_ON_SAVE
scenarios.evidence: Live checkpoint/finalize/reopen RPCs verify expected run and stage state_version and fail closed.

scenarios.name: CONNECTOR_FAILURE_DURING_LOAD
scenarios.evidence: Frozen protocol is fail-closed, but LOAD orchestration/fallback path is not implemented.

scenarios.name: PERSISTENCE_FAILURE_DURING_SAVE
scenarios.evidence: Transactional stage RPCs and persistence receipts exist; end-to-end ChatGPT SAVE orchestration still must be implemented.

scenarios.name: INVALID_EVIDENCE_ID
scenarios.evidence: Artifact resolver validates artifact identity/hash/authority, but analytical Evidence IDs inside V2 artifacts need dedicated validation.

scenarios.name: LONG_DEEP_DIVE_CHECKPOINT
scenarios.evidence: Live checkpoint RPC, CHECKPOINT manifest semantics and immutable artifact registry are present.

scenarios.name: RED_TEAM_REOPENS_EARLIER_BLOCK
scenarios.evidence: Stage reopen exists, but analytical block-level dependency reopening is not implemented.

scenarios.name: PRICE_ONLY_DELTA
scenarios.evidence: Refresh class exists in V2 code/contracts; new ChatGPT workflow must preserve no-fundamental-rerun semantics.

scenarios.name: ROUTINE_FUNDAMENTAL_DELTA
scenarios.evidence: Affected-block dependency reopening requires the new state machine.

scenarios.name: FULL_REFRESH_REQUIRED
scenarios.evidence: Successor-run lineage exists; ChatGPT refresh routing and block reset logic remain to design.

scenarios.name: SAVE_WITHOUT_STAGE_COMPLETION
scenarios.evidence: CHECKPOINT manifests cannot admit downstream stage; live stage trigger/RPC enforces separation.

scenarios.name: COMPLETE_STAGE_FINALIZES
scenarios.evidence: Finalization RPC and required stage outputs exist; ChatGPT SAVE must detect eligibility and call it correctly.

scenarios.name: SAVE_NEVER_PUBLISHES
scenarios.evidence: Publication has separate authorization/result RPCs and READY_TO_PUBLISH boundary.

scenarios.name: GO_PUBLISH_INVALID_INTEGRATION
scenarios.evidence: Publish authorization requires READY_TO_PUBLISH/Integration candidate state and separate authorization.
